name: Petrobras managed-pressure drilling programme, offshore Brazil pre-salt
description: 2 rigs equipped for MPD as of mid-2014, planned expansion to 12 by end-2015 and 16 by 2016; seven wells drilled with MPD at the time

sources.note: JPT (SPE), 30 Jun 2014: "Petrobras now has two drilling rigs working offshore Brazil equipped to do managed-pressure drilling, and plans to expand this total to 12..."; Lula field re-entry: "drill 89m with minor (fluid) losses" then 70 m more under pressurised mud-cap drilling (read 2026-10-28)
